# ATHENOA

> ATHENOA is a Cultural Sanctuary which rekindles Ancient Hellenic Wisdom as a living path of self-realization, sacred education, and civic virtue.

Guided by the Archetype of Goddess Athena, we illuminate the way from intellectual learning to embodied knowing, from philosophy to inner awakening—restoring our relationship with Nature, with Soul, and with the World.

## Live Courses

- [Odyssey](https://www.athenoa.academy/en/courses/odusseia.md): In this Cycle of Studies in Greek Philosophy we will study the Odyssey as a timeless treasure of Wisdom, a symbolic Map of the human Soul and of its Journey to Self-knowledge and Awakening.
- [Εὖ Ζῆν](https://www.athenoa.academy/en/courses/eu-zen.md): Philosophy as the Art of Living: an experiential path to becoming, each day, who we truly are.
- [The Hidden Non-Duality of Ancient Greek Philosophy](https://www.athenoa.academy/en/courses/the-hidden-non-duality-of-ancient-greek-philosophy.md): Each week we will delve into the non-dual teaching expressed by the following great Philosophers ~ Ancient Sages: Plotinus, Plato, Pythagoras, The Pre-Socratics
